subject: Re: Willow Systems — MAP & evaluation material exchange (timeline & usage constraints)
messages:
From: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@willow.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Marco Chen <marco.chen@willow.ai>, Willow Systems Legal <legal@willow.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Willow: sharing eval assets and MAP proposal

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Willow is excited about Redwood's routing and cost controls. To keep momentum, we want to share an initial evaluation bundle and a proposed mutual action plan so we can close before the end of Q2 (our procurement window is tight).

What we will share today (drop in Drive + S3 presigned link):
- willow_eval_dataset_v1_manifest.csv (5k anonymized test cases; metadata included)
- willow_prompt-pack_v2.pdf (30 canonical prompts + expected labels)
- a short rubric (.xlsx) with pass/fail / soft metrics we use for acceptance

Constraints from Willow legal/security:
- Assets are for evaluation only; no sublicensing or public redistribution.
- Redwood may run up to 500k tokens for evaluation usage.
- Any retention beyond 30 days requires explicit approval.

Proposed MAP highlights (dates are draft):
- Jun 25: asset exchange & access granted
- Jun 26–29: Redwood runs baseline evals and shares initial scorecard
- Jun 30: joint sync to review results and finalize PO/contract terms

Please confirm who on your side will own the MAP, whether you need formal IAM/S3 access, and any questions on the usage constraints. I attached the manifest and prompt pack to the Drive folder; I can also send a signed MAP if needed.

Thanks,
Asha
Asha Reddy
Head of ML Ops, Willow Systems
Attachments: willow_eval_dataset_v1_manifest.csv (csv), willow_prompt-pack_v2.pdf (pdf)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@willow.ai>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Willow: sharing eval assets and MAP proposal

Hi Asha — thanks for the package and the clear MAP. We're aligned on cadence and appreciate the constraints you spelled out.

Quick responses / owners:
- MAP owner on Redwood: Jon (me) — I'll be the main contact for scheduling and acceptance criteria.
- Technical lead for evals: Camila (cc'd) — she'll run the baseline passes and produce the scorecard.
- Security/retention point: Vivek (cc'd) — will confirm retention handling and confirm the 30-day rule.

Access: please send an S3 presigned read-only bundle to infra@redwood.com and add camila_reyes@redwood.com and dev_patel@redwood.com as access recipients. We prefer the S3 link for large artifacts and will pull into a private bucket that Redwood controls.

MAP: attached is a one-sheet MAP template I filled with our proposed milestones and acceptance gates (MAP_Willow-Redwood_20260630.xlsx). Key changes I suggested:
- Acceptance gate A: pass rate >= 78% on core intent set (see rubric tab)
- Retention default: 30 days from ingestion; encrypted-at-rest; audit log backfill for any re-runs
- If a regression >5% is observed between Jun 26–29 runs, we schedule a rollback meeting on Jun 29.

Next steps: Camila will start baseline runs once we have the S3 link. Can Willow confirm whether the prompt pack includes expected labels for all test cases (some vendors provide partial labels)?

Jon
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0147
From: camila_reyes@redwood.com
To: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@willow.ai>, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Willow: sharing eval assets and MAP proposal

Asha — thanks, the manifest looks clean. A couple of technical clarifications before we pull the dataset: 

1) Label coverage: the manifest shows label_coverage = 92% on the first 3k rows; can you confirm whether the remaining 8% are intentionally unlabeled (we can still run blind evals but need to mark them as such)?
2) Schema: please confirm the CSV uses UTF-8 without BOM and that the expected columns are: case_id, prompt, expected_label, split, tags.
3) Personally Identifiable Information (PII): we ran a quick scan on the sample and found 2 examples flagged for potential phone numbers. Please confirm they were redacted per your stated anonymization procedure.

Security/ingest notes:
- We'll ingest into a private, ephemeral bucket and run evals inside our VPC. After the 30-day retention period we'll delete objects and produce a deletion certificate.
- For long-term retention requests (beyond 30 days) please route requests through legal to vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com.

Dev (cc): once we have the S3 link I'll schedule the batch runs (we expect 12–18 hours for the initial sweep with our default batch size).

Camila Reyes
Applied ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: willow_prompt-pack_v2.pdf (already in Drive)
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@willow.ai>, camila_reyes@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Willow: sharing eval assets and MAP proposal

Folks — quick note from security/legal side to make sure we're covered before running the full pass: 

1) Usage license: Redwood will treat the dataset and prompt pack as "evaluation-only" per Willow's language. We will not use the assets to train models without explicit, written permission from Willow's legal team. Please confirm you are okay with the following clause (we can add to the MAP): 
   "Evaluation Data Use: Redwood may use Willow-provided evaluation materials for up to 30 days for the sole purpose of assessing model performance. Any use beyond evaluation requires prior written consent from Willow Systems legal."

2) Redlines: I reviewed the prompt pack and propose a narrow redline to the attribution section clarifying that Redwood's internal model telemetry collected during eval is used only for debugging and for producing the scorecard; aggregated artifacts will not be retained beyond the retention window.

3) Audit: please provide the Drive link to the manifest and the S3 presigned link with object-level checksums. We will record checksums in our ingestion log.

If Willow is comfortable with the clause above, Laura can incorporate it into the MAP and we can proceed to run the evaluations on Jun 30 as planned.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@willow.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: Marco Chen <marco.chen@willow.ai>, Willow Systems Legal <legal@willow.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Willow: sharing eval assets and MAP proposal

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turn. A few confirmations from Willow: 

- Label coverage: the 8% unlabeled rows are intentional (holdouts); you'll see expected_label = "" for those. We understand blind eval behavior.
- PII: confirmed redacted per our data-handling SOP; I attached the redaction report to the Drive folder.
- S3 link: presigned read-only bundle sent to infra@redwood.com earlier today (link expires Jul 2). Objects include SHA256 checksums in the manifest file.
- Legal clause: Willow accepts the proposed "Evaluation Data Use" clause. Our legal team has attached a signed MAP with the clause included (Willow_signed_MAP_20260630.pdf).

Final for MAP kickoff:
- Jun 30 10:00 PDT: Redwood runs baseline sweep and uploads scorecard to the shared Drive folder.
- Jul 1 09:00 PDT: Joint review call to review scorecard and discuss acceptance gate results.
- If acceptance gate passed, Willow issues PO and we push to procurement on Jul 5.

I'll attach the signed MAP to this thread and lane it to your legal queue. Looking forward to results.

Best,
Asha
Asha Reddy
Head of ML Ops, Willow Systems
Attachments: Willow_signed_MAP_20260630.pdf (pdf)
